description: This file implements the basic functions of the Ansc Broker Engine Tcp Object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal. It defines the creation function AnscBetoCreate, the cleanup function AnscBetoRemove, and initialization functions like AnscBetoInitialize, setting up member variables, locks, events, and function pointers, forming part of a networking service system.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscBetoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs the Ansc Broker Engine Tcp Object, allocating memory, setting name, context and function pointers, then enrolling and initializing objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBetoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the object by stopping, resetting, freeing events and locks, and removing the object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBetoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all required sub-objects for the broker engine object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscBetoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the member variables and function pointers for the broker engine object, setting up states, events, locks, and internal data structures.
